## Soma Bra & Intimates Store FAQ’s

### What products does Soma offer?

Looking for a bra store that works as hard as you do? We design and
sell [bras][56], [panties][57], [lingerie,][58] [shapewear][59], [pajamas][60], [swimwear][61],[ bra
dresses][62], and [apparel items][63] that are as beautiful as they are innovative. No compromises.
 

### What are some of Soma’s most popular items?

Some of our most popular products feature innovative solutions including our best-selling Cool
Nights® pajamas. They’re made with lightweight fabric that is cool to the touch and it helps prevent
them from sticking to your body. In addition, they have hidden pockets to hold your small essentials
and endless prints to choose from. With over 16 million sold, millions of women get a good night’s
sleep with Cool Nights®. 

Among our women’s intimates, our Enbliss® collection, including bras and bralettes with cloud-soft
support, is loved by many. You can expect a serious lift without wires in various styles and
silhouettes for your everyday needs. 

Likewise, if you’re on the hunt for an underwear store with unique solutions, you’ve come to the
right place. Our Vanishing Edge® panties have patented no-show technology that keeps panties in
place and ensures a no-ride, no-roll, no-show finish.  

### Can I find a variety of sizes for Bras & Underwear at Soma?

Soma® carries an array of sizes across bra collections including select styles ranging from 32-44
bands and A-I cups. We also carry a wide variety of panties with select styles ranging from XS-XXL.
We have several types of bras including wireless bras, push-up bras, bralettes, strapless, sports
bras, and more.

### How can I find a Soma store near me?

To locate a Soma® intimates and bra store near you, head to our [store locator][64] to search by
address or zip code, and boutique type. Among the search features, you have the option to use your
current location to find the closest Soma® intimates store near you along with filtering by stores
that provide In-Store and Curbside Pick-up. We are proud to offer in-store bra fittings so you can
find the perfect bra for your size, style, outfit, and more.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

## Advanced Manufacturing Capacity

Our modern production facility is equipped with automated production lines to ensure stable
production and consistent quality.

Key capabilities include:
* 8 automated stainless steel bottle production lines
* Monthly production capacity of up to **500,000 bottles**
* Precision laser welding technology
* Advanced vacuum insulation equipment

This allows us to efficiently handle both **small custom orders and large-scale production**.

## Food Grade Stainless Steel Materials

All our bottles are made from **high-quality food-grade stainless steel**, ensuring safety,
durability, and long-term use.

Material options include:
* **304 stainless steel** – industry standard for drinkware
* **316 stainless steel** – higher corrosion resistance for premium products

Our products are:
* BPA free
* odor-free
* rust-resistant
* safe for daily use

These materials ensure your brand delivers safe and reliable products to customers.

## Strict Quality Control System

Quality is the foundation of our manufacturing process.

Every bottle goes through multiple inspection stages, including:
* Raw material inspection
* Welding quality checks
* Vacuum insulation testing
* 100% leak testing
* Final product inspection

Our quality control team ensures that each bottle meets international quality standards before
shipment.

This helps our clients maintain **excellent product reputation and customer satisfaction**.

## Fast Customization & Flexible OEM Production

We specialize in **OEM and private label stainless steel water bottles**, helping brands quickly
develop customized products for their markets.

Our experienced team supports the entire customization process, including product design, logo
branding, color matching, and packaging development.

Customization capabilities include:
* Custom logo printing (laser engraving, silk screen, heat transfer)
* Pantone color matching and powder coating finishes
* Custom packaging design for retail or e-commerce
* Flexible MOQ starting from **100 pieces per design**

With our efficient workflow, we can complete **sample production within 3–5 days**, allowing you to
test new designs and launch products faster.

This fast customization capability makes us an ideal manufacturing partner for **brands,
distributors, and Amazon sellers**.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.

* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

## Natuvion: Your expert in intelligent data transformation with AI

### We move data to move your forward

Natuvion is your digital moving company. We don’t move desks, filing cabinets, or chairs – we move
your most valuable assets: your data and business processes – securely, reliably, and with minimal
downtime. Our mission? To ensure you can leverage them across the most innovative platforms, and lay
the foundation for modern technologies, smart automation, and data-driven business processes.

From initial analysis through migration to smooth operation of your new solution – we support you
every step of the way with deep transformation expertise and intelligent software. For a seamless
and efficient IT transformation.

## One approach. Whatever your migration takes.

### The Natuvion ONE Data Transformation Approach

With the Natuvion ONE Data Transformation Approach (ODTA), we offer a flexible solution for the
migration of enterprise data across IT platforms in all its forms, regardless of the source and
target platform or the chosen migration scenario (Brownfield, Greenfield, or Selective Data
Transition).

You benefit from a fully integrated platform designed to address all data transformation challenges.
We support your transformation end-to-end – from the initial analysis and migration right through to
the decommissioning of legacy systems.

# Eco-friendly Bamboo Products Manufacturer from Vietnam

Oceans Republic is a leading eco-friendly Bamboo Product Manufacturer from Vietnam.

We are the largest international supplier of Bamboo Tableware, bamboo kitchenware, bamboo cookware,
bamboo travel ware, bamboo oral care, bamboo personal care, bamboo hotel amenities, bamboo bar, and
restaurant items. 

Oceans Republic manufactured eco-friendly & sustainable bamboo products are: Bamboo Cup, Bamboo
Cutlery, Bamboo Canister, Bamboo bowls, Bamboo bottle, Bamboo Straws, Bamboo Toothbrush, Bamboo
Cutting Boards and Bamboo Boxes. We can make any customized bamboo products for International and
domestic Bamboo products brands.

Our bamboo factory has all the latest types of machinery needed and well-trained staff to serve the
B2B clients. We continuously upgrade ourselves to produce the most innovative and high-end bamboo
products considering the demand of our clients.

We care about your well-being and the planet. Our eco-friendly bamboo products are free from animal
cruelty. We have natural & sustainable bamboo products for everyone. 

## About Oceans Republic

Oceans Republic is a social enterprise that was officially incorporated in 2020 for international
bamboo and rattan export. We are quickly becoming a major Vietnamese manufacturer and supplier of
eco-friendly bamboo products in North America and the European Union.


So far, Oceans Republic has manufactured & exported millions of biodegradable & eco-friendly bamboo
products like bamboo straws, cutleries, toothbrushes that will greatly reduce the impact on our
environment and contribute to a better, cleaner world.

Ocean Republic's products are made entirely from sustainably cultivated Vietnamese bamboo. Our
bamboo products are SGS tested and safe for end-user.

Since 2022, we've added Acacia kitchenware and tableware to our range. Buyers can now easily order
eco-friendly products like bamboo, acacia, rattan, and coconut all in one place.

# Eco-friendly Bamboo Products Manufacturer from Vietnam

Oceans Republic is a leading eco-friendly Bamboo Product Manufacturer from Vietnam.

We are the largest international supplier of Bamboo Tableware, bamboo kitchenware, bamboo cookware,
bamboo travel ware, bamboo oral care, bamboo personal care, bamboo hotel amenities, bamboo bar, and
restaurant items. 

Oceans Republic manufactured eco-friendly & sustainable bamboo products are: Bamboo Cup, Bamboo
Cutlery, Bamboo Canister, Bamboo bowls, Bamboo bottle, Bamboo Straws, Bamboo Toothbrush, Bamboo
Cutting Boards and Bamboo Boxes. We can make any customized bamboo products for International and
domestic Bamboo products brands.

Our bamboo factory has all the latest types of machinery needed and well-trained staff to serve the
B2B clients. We continuously upgrade ourselves to produce the most innovative and high-end bamboo
products considering the demand of our clients.

We care about your well-being and the planet. Our eco-friendly bamboo products are free from animal
cruelty. We have natural & sustainable bamboo products for everyone. 

## About Oceans Republic

Oceans Republic is a social enterprise that was officially incorporated in 2020 for international
bamboo and rattan export. We are quickly becoming a major Vietnamese manufacturer and supplier of
eco-friendly bamboo products in North America and the European Union.


So far, Oceans Republic has manufactured & exported millions of biodegradable & eco-friendly bamboo
products like bamboo straws, cutleries, toothbrushes that will greatly reduce the impact on our
environment and contribute to a better, cleaner world.

Ocean Republic's products are made entirely from sustainably cultivated Vietnamese bamboo. Our
bamboo products are SGS tested and safe for end-user.

Since 2022, we've added Acacia kitchenware and tableware to our range. Buyers can now easily order
eco-friendly products like bamboo, acacia, rattan, and coconut all in one place.

## International Bamboo Products Manufacturer

If you're looking for high-quality bamboo products, Oceans Republic is the perfect bamboo products
manufacturer for you. We're one of the leading bamboo manufacturing companies in Vietnam, and we're
dedicated to providing our customers with the best possible product and service.

The selection of our international bamboo products are not only of the highest quality, but are also
available in a variety of options to ensure you find exactly what you’re looking for. With
top-of-the-line materials, cutting-edge production technologies and a highly qualified team, we
guarantee complete satisfaction.

Check out our wide range of bamboo tableware, bamboo kitchenware, bamboo bathroom accessories &
office furniture which we export to our B2B clients worldwide.  And because we source our bamboo
from sustainably managed forests, you can be sure that your purchase is supporting a sustainable
industry. 

## Bamboo Tableware Manufacturer

Bamboo tableware is gaining popularity for its environmental benefits and stylishness. Oceans
Republic is dedicated to protecting the environment by providing an alternative to plastic
tableware. Our tableware is a versatile and environmentally-friendly option for your dining needs.
It is durable, heat-resistant, and even dishwasher-safe, making it perfect for everything from a
casual family dinner to an elegant soiree. 

Oceans Republic manufactures a wide variety of reusable bamboo cutlery, bamboo bowls, bamboo plates,
bamboo cups and bamboo trays which are biodegradable, compostable and sustainable. It also doesn't
leach toxins into food like plastic tableware does. Eco-conscious businesses will love our bamboo
tableware because it is a great way to reduce their impact on the environment.

### Custom Labeled Water Bottles in Florida

[Custom Labeled Water]Custom labeled water from Piedmont Springs can provide an outstanding
promotional opportunity for all types of businesses and groups. Whether you’re looking for a way to
make an impression on hotel guests in Savannah, or you want to spread the word about your
organization at an outdoor event in Jacksonville, [private label bottled water][19] makes an
effective advertising option.

At Piedmont Springs, we’re dedicated to delivering a high-quality product that meets or exceeds our
clients’ expectations. That’s why we take steps to make our [personalized water][20] bottlelabels
the best they can be. Our experienced professionals will work closely with you throughout the
designing process to ensure that your label looks exactly the way you envisioned it. When you deem
the design satisfactory and give your approval on it, we can print the labels. We also take the
extra step of laminating the [custom water bottle labels][21] in order to prevent the peeling,
fading, and disintegration you might experience with flimsier labels.

In addition to our label designing expertise, there are other reasons to choose Piedmont Springs
over other [custom labeled water][22] providers. These advantages include:
* Quick turnaround time – From the time you approve the label design to the moment your water
  arrives at its destination, it only takes two to three weeks for you to receive the finished water
  bottles.
* Durable [private label water bottles][23] – They are made of thicker plastic than the average
  water bottle, allowing them to hold up better in storage and during use.
* Outstanding selection – We offer 8-, 12-, 16.9-, and 20-ounce regular bottles, as well as a
  16.9-ounce bullet bottle.

[Contact][24] Piedmont Springs today to find out more about our custom labeled water options. We’re
happy to serve clients in Augusta, Birmingham, Orlando, Chattanooga, Charleston, and across the
country.

### Custom Labeled Water Bottles in Florida

[Custom Labeled Water]Custom labeled water from Piedmont Springs can provide an outstanding
promotional opportunity for all types of businesses and groups. Whether you’re looking for a way to
make an impression on hotel guests in Savannah, or you want to spread the word about your
organization at an outdoor event in Jacksonville, [private label bottled water][19] makes an
effective advertising option.

At Piedmont Springs, we’re dedicated to delivering a high-quality product that meets or exceeds our
clients’ expectations. That’s why we take steps to make our [personalized water][20] bottlelabels
the best they can be. Our experienced professionals will work closely with you throughout the
designing process to ensure that your label looks exactly the way you envisioned it. When you deem
the design satisfactory and give your approval on it, we can print the labels. We also take the
extra step of laminating the [custom water bottle labels][21] in order to prevent the peeling,
fading, and disintegration you might experience with flimsier labels.

In addition to our label designing expertise, there are other reasons to choose Piedmont Springs
over other [custom labeled water][22] providers. These advantages include:
* Quick turnaround time – From the time you approve the label design to the moment your water
  arrives at its destination, it only takes two to three weeks for you to receive the finished water
  bottles.
* Durable [private label water bottles][23] – They are made of thicker plastic than the average
  water bottle, allowing them to hold up better in storage and during use.
* Outstanding selection – We offer 8-, 12-, 16.9-, and 20-ounce regular bottles, as well as a
  16.9-ounce bullet bottle.

[Contact][24] Piedmont Springs today to find out more about our custom labeled water options. We’re
happy to serve clients in Augusta, Birmingham, Orlando, Chattanooga, Charleston, and across the
country.

# Your custom product team in Asia

Helping you manufacture promo, merch, and other custom products in Asia from design to delivery

[ Start a Project ][162]

## Branded Product Program Experts

Branded promotional items and merchandise are what we do best. Full merchandise ranges, large
events, custom product catalogs — we’ve delivered them. We work from your brief, not a fixed
catalog.

We pair an in-house apparel factory producing high-quality sports uniforms and everyday wear with a
wider network of vetted factories, so the production setup gets built around your project instead of
the other way around.

Behind that sits an in-house design team across every kind of printing, deep expertise in
eco-friendly materials and products, and the experience to handle projects with strict requirements
and custom logistics.

[ Product Range ][163]

## On-the-Ground Manufacturing Partner

You get more than a supplier. You get an Australian-led team on the ground in China, working
directly from your brief and shaping our services around what your project actually needs.

water bottles globally for many brands. We have 34 years of experience in producing 100 million

and recyclable. None of our products has any flavor or scent to them. Over many years, we have
received several Export Appreciation Awards from the Government of India. Using a different bottle
for each activity, Premsons offers a distinctive bottle for each of its brands.



**"We accept only bulk quantity orders."**

# Over 35 Years of Hardscape Excellence

## We Always Put Our Partners First

We are a family-owned and operated national hardscape and landscape accessory company with a mission
to be your one-stop shop for any hardscape or landscape project.

Whether you need products for over, around, below, or beyond your projects, we have the solutions
and expertise you need to do the job. SRW Products is committed to the success of our dealers and
contractors who trust our brand to deliver.

Everything from the packaging of our products to the extensive library of educational videos,
guides, and support services we provide you were assembled to provide you with the best solutions
for extraordinary hardscapes and landscapes.

INTRODUCING THE NEW
Rock Binder™

[ EXPLORE ROCK BINDER™ NOW ][52]
SRW Rock Binder™

SRW Rock Binder™ bonds and stabilizes rocks and aggregates to reduce the effects of blow-out from
heavy wind or leaf blowers, washout from heavy rain, and other environmental elements. Safe for use
around children, plants, and animals. The surface remains flexible, allowing water to pass through.

# Over 35 Years of Hardscape Excellence

## We Always Put Our Partners First

We are a family-owned and operated national hardscape and landscape accessory company with a mission
to be your one-stop shop for any hardscape or landscape project.

Whether you need products for over, around, below, or beyond your projects, we have the solutions
and expertise you need to do the job. SRW Products is committed to the success of our dealers and
contractors who trust our brand to deliver.

Everything from the packaging of our products to the extensive library of educational videos,
guides, and support services we provide you were assembled to provide you with the best solutions
for extraordinary hardscapes and landscapes.

INTRODUCING THE NEW
Rock Binder™
LOCKS MATERIALS IN PLACE AND PROVIDES COLOR ENHANCEMENT
[ EXPLORE ROCK BINDER™ NOW ][52]
SRW Rock Binder™

SRW Rock Binder™ bonds and stabilizes rocks and aggregates to reduce the effects of blow-out from
heavy wind or leaf blowers, washout from heavy rain, and other environmental elements. Safe for use
around children, plants, and animals. The surface remains flexible, allowing water to pass through.

# Experience Counts

## SERVICES

The SWB Group provides remote web-based application support and system administration services for
clients using or implementing UKG Workforce Central®, UKG Dimensions®, ADP Time and Attendance® and
ADP Vantage Time®. We offer our services in project leadership and management, migrations,
implementations, configuration support, and integration configuration and support.

[More Info][6]

## PROJECTS

Our projects have included time and labor management requirements gathering and configuration,
scheduling and absence management configuration, data migration and conversions, lead consulting,
customized training, project management, as well as import and export integrations (both flat-file
and API). We also provide implementation go-live and ongoing support services for our clients.

[More Info][7]

## CLIENTS

With hundreds of clients over the past 30+ years, we have extensive expertise implementing UKG
Workforce Central, UKG Dimensions, ADP Enterprise eTime, ADP Vantage Time, and Boomi integrations
for organizations of all sizes in many industries, including union and non-union healthcare,
manufacturing, distribution, transportation, higher education and retail organizations.

[More Info][8]

## ABOUT US

The SWB Group consulting team has over 30 years industry experience providing specialized consulting
services for UKG and ADP workforce management applications for complex organizations of all sizes
and industries.

 

Our years of experience and industry best practice expertise implementing and supporting workforce
management solutions help clients optimize performance, improve satisfaction, streamline business
practices and reduce labor costs.

[Learn More][9]

through this comprehensive circular ecosystem.
